title: In America
author: William Saville
content:
In america.
The young die,
The old die.
Of things that can be prevented.
Gunshots and healthcare,
Not talked about enough,
When we try to take a knee,
We make them uneasy.
There isn't enough money,
For food for young children,
But there is enough money,
For the right wing's new villain.
The right wing doesn't care,
About all the people dying,
They get their tax cuts,
But when they don't get their way,
They're left crying.
Stuff their pockets full of money,
They can't spend in a lifetime.
Complaining about welfare,
And grants and education,
They get mad when we are educated.
Because that means less deductions.
Corporate welfare and subsidies,
Now THEY are the drain on the system,
Not a grandmother in a nursing home,
Or a young kid getting free meals.
Their mom on foodstamps,
Working two jobs to get by.
We have right wing nutjobs with so many marriages,
So many kids from so many people.
But they try and deny us the right to marry for love,
Once we got that right now they try to take it away.
Healthcare is a privledge but guns are a right.
Well, what about all the people,
Shot out in broad daylight?
So many people with so much anger and hate,
Yet they make it easier to get guns.
They are silent for nazis,
Saying they have freedom of speech,
It's hate they fight FOR not against,
But condemn our black sons kneeling,
And ignore Puerto Rico and veteran plights?
Tweeting from a golden tower.
Wanting more and more power.
They send our sons and daughters to war,
But refuse to help them when they return,
Half dead inside,
With the war still in their head and ears.
Waking up each night in fear.
Life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
These are fundamental rights.
We have laws against certain things,
That make people happy,
Such as committing armed robbery.
Hurting people and things.
But we have no laws to take care of the sick and dying,
Or those who are trying,
Trying to climb up,
And their fingers get stepped on.
Their hearts torn open by vultures.
Only in American culture,
Are we told we are free.
But that freedom is only for those who can afford to pay.
Only for those who think a certain way.
That is not freedom.
And if you think otherwise.
You are either not free,
Or you are part of the problem
